podcasts.title: SAP CEO: AI Won't Kill Software, But It Will Change Your Job — With Christian Klein
podcasts.why_useful: A detailed discussion of AI reliability, business context, data quality, governance, reskilling, model choice, and how agents may change enterprise software and jobs.

podcasts.title: Could AI really end humanity?
podcasts.why_useful: A current Financial Times interview with Toby Ord on AI capability, misuse, loss of control, governance, and the limits of present systems, adding a risk-and-governance counterpoint to the edition's deployment stories.

verification_note: Both podcasts were published inside the 48-hour primary window and are from distinct shows/publishers. The Big Technology episode runtime is independently indexed at 62 minutes; the Rachman Review episode identity and October 1 publication are confirmed by Acast, Financial Times, and Apple Podcasts.
